card.does: Opens or closes a gap in the power line when you press it.
card.gives: Gives: a way to stop and start the power.
card.needs: Needs: a place in the power line (red), between the battery pack and a part.
card.popularMechanics: The light switch on your wall opens and closes a gap in the same way.
card.safetyNote: Real switches are small parts, so build with an adult nearby.

failureModes.cardLine: Across the battery pack: closing it drains the pack fast.
failureModes.hint: This switch closes a loop with nothing in it that uses power
failureModes.teachingNote: A switch wired straight across the battery pack joins plus to minus when it closes, so closing it makes a short circuit instead of turning a part on.

failureModes.cardLine: Not in the loop: pressing it changes nothing.
failureModes.hint: This switch is not in a loop with the battery pack
failureModes.teachingNote: A switch starts and stops only the loop it sits in. Wired off to one side, with no loop running through it, pressing it changes nothing.
